questions.question_english: What is the fundamental distinction between Synchronous and Asynchronous digital learning modes?

questions.explanation_english: Synchronous involves real-time live interaction, whereas Asynchronous involves self-paced learning. Digital learning methodologies are categorized into synchronous and asynchronous interaction modes based on time synchronization. Synchronous learning involves real-time, simultaneous interaction between instructors and students through tools like live webcasts, video conferencing, and live chat. Conversely, asynchronous learning allows students to access recorded lectures, reading materials, self-assessment quizzes, and discussion forums at their own convenience and pace, independent of fixed scheduled instructional hours.
